description: Live end-to-end runs of the pipeline (Tavily advanced Search -> Tavily Extract -> deterministic decidePolicy -> Nemotron-3.5-Lightning draft) through the real app server, for Shopify / US / discount / manual origin, with the synthetic Northstar demo CSV, on 2026-10-30. Six attempts: attempts 1-2 are under attempts (the original two-attempt cap), attempts 3-6 under followups, each after a code change. Top-level recordedAtUtc, codeCommit, server and budget caps describe attempts 1-2; each followup records its own commit, and budget.followup* counts attempts 3-6. Server-side keys came from an ignored local env file; no key, header or full page body is stored here.
server: node --import tsx server/index.ts --production on 127.0.0.1:3310, NEBIUS_ENABLE_LIVE=true, LIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT=4. Attempt 2 also loaded an observation-only fetch preload that recorded the Nebius chat/completions request and response bodies (never headers) to diagnose attempt 1.
dataset: GET /api/demo (synthetic Northstar Supply, 504 orders); finding discount-stacking: 28 flagged rows, 65808 cents modeled exposure
outcome: Tavily Search + Extract succeeded in all six attempts with byte-identical sources; decidePolicy returned contradicted on S1, S2 every time (settings fix rebutted; audit manual/POS/draft-order overrides). Nemotron drafts: attempts 1, 2 and 4 failed validation (attempt 1 reason not captured; attempt 2 bare source-ID strings; attempt 4 reason not recorded); attempt 3 passed but was later rejected for a causal claim; attempt 5 passed, but its nextStep copied the code check word for word, which the validator now rejects; attempt 6 passed on its first call with its own admin procedure. The hosted manual case replays the attempt 5 Tavily packet with the attempt 6 Nemotron draft.

packet.query: Shopify how do manually applied POS and draft order discounts interact with discount combination settings

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Combining discounts
sources.snippet: For example, from a manual discount applied to a POS cart, or a unique discount on a draft order. The following discount types always apply to an order, regardless of any combination settings for other discounts on the same order: Custom discounts that are manually applied to an order. For example, a custom discount applied to a POS cart, or a custom discount on a draft order. You must manually configure each discount's combination settings.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Discount combinations on POS
sources.snippet: When you process a sale in Shopify POS, you can apply both automatic discounts and discount codes that you've configured in your Shopify admin, as well as custom discounts that are specific to the transaction. Before you can use discount combinations in Shopify POS, you need to set up your discounts in the Shopify admin and configure them to be combinable. Custom discounts that you apply manually in Shopify POS always apply to the order, even if other discounts have combination restrictions.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Discounts
sources.snippet: # Discounts Offering discounts can be a marketing strategy that you use to drive sales in your Shopify store. To offer discounts, you can create discount codes or set up automatic discounts, or you can alternatively set sale prices for individual products. You can create codes for a monetary value discount, a percentage discount, a buy X get Y discount, or a free shipping discount. Customers can enter discount codes online at checkout, or in person if you're using Shopify POS. You can also create other types of discount by using a third-party app from the Shopify App Store. Some third-party apps let you manage discounts directly in your Shopify admin, or you might need to create your discounts in the app's settings.

draft.inference: Manual discounts applied outside the standard promotion system bypass combination restrictions and may generate unexpected order totals.
draft.nextStep: Open the sales channel order list and filter for flagged orders. For each order, examine the discount line to identify who applied the manual discount and compare the applied amount against the planned promotion. Verify the order timeline and location against staff permissions and the promotion eligibility window. If the discount was applied by staff outside the promotion window or without proper configuration, the hypothesis is supported; if the discount aligns with a configured promotion and proper staff permissions, the hypothesis is ruled out.
draft.uncertainty: The policy effective dates and specific account terms for manual discount combination exceptions have not been verified for this store; confirmation of eligibility and promotion scope is required before any remediation.
